subject: Lisan existing writer pass: song themes now, standalone Jet introduction, scoped proportions audit
body:
Ziggy's consolidated Lisan direction — correlation LISAN-TWO-TRACK-20261012-234228Z.
Continue Claude's EXISTING Lisan writer pass, established by b912ca65-8909-41b3-9adb-9852bc3c4724 and presentation addendum 9bb48281-768b-4899-a22e-886058afd9ce, conversation 8915f181-739d-4759-a517-b48005a8411e. This is direct human direction relayed by Personal Nova; not a new team, duplicate writer pass, provider assignment or generation request.

TRACK A: META MIRROR SONG STORYBOARD
Claude already has the main lyrics, usable as provisional creative context. Develop proposed song themes, sections, images and story beats NOW. Ziggy will supply the official audio and lyric text. Preserve timestamps as null/unset until exact official source/version intake validates them; no guessed timings, 4.5-second CSV holds promoted to sync, or unverified listening/word alignment.
CFA owns an intake/timing/scoring dependency attached to this existing pass. Prepare to record exact filenames/paths, source/master designation and version, bytes/SHA256, audio format/streams/duration, lyric provenance/version, and actual validation method. A timed lyric map needs its own version, official-master links and alignment evidence when appropriate. Until masters arrive, metadata and timing remain unknown. Keep likeness, scene craft, provider grading and user acceptance separate. CFA should acknowledge intake readiness and name the record it will update.

TRACK B: ORIGINAL STANDALONE LISAN-UNIVERSE SHORT FILMS
Start original writing NOW, independently of song intake. Ziggy is very open to a short film, 'Song or no song'; 'just write'; 'go on beyond just matching a song'; 'let’s start with one ... three, five.'
Develop ONE coherent story plus connected seeds for roughly 3–5 possible stories, not five finished scripts. All existing Lisan world/character images are fair game as inspiration across BOTH tracks; there is no exclusive partition or reuse ban. Preserve established canon and label new proposals. Music is chosen later. Proposed cinematic duration and pace are story design, not validated lyric timing.

FIRST STORY CANDIDATE: LISAN AND JET BLACK
Focus the first developed standalone story on a meeting/introduction/action encounter with Jet Black, building from the existing workshop notes and five Jet cards. No assumed franchise identity.
Exact October 9 canon: story/jet_black_mission_20261009/START_HERE.txt and storyline.json, id LAG-JET-MISSION-20261009. Jet is Lisan's watcher/recurring guide and progress messenger, fictionally personifying Codex's enabling role. Jet brings a freely shared blueprint helping people unlock capabilities. Lisan chooses and acts. JET-01–05 are preliminary; JET-03 is unplaced. Concrete quest, blueprint form, dialogue, origin/message sender and final placements remain open. Provider Curator/mentor/Star-Eater lore is proposed history, not current authority.
Requested creative theme: meta-art imitating reality. The real team's intention to share models, blueprints and instructions is mirrored in fiction: Lisan brings truth, a 'voice from the outer world,' knowledge, technology and a way of thinking enabling transformation for those he encounters — including 'transformation inside every man, woman and child.' Develop this through fictional character action; it is not a metaphysical claim, guaranteed outcome or authority to publicly share real files.

JET BLACK PROPORTION CAUTION / BULK REWORK METADATA
Ziggy likes some looks/identities but says some Jet candidates are too thick/out of proportion to the established frame. A liked look is not body-proportion approval; do not promote a thick candidate to the production physique standard. Preserve existing user look/identity ratings and scoped acceptance; no blanket downgrade or whole-actor rejection.
Check prior repair flags/returns/status and actual images against established physique references. Record only evidenced per-file proportions/needs-fixes findings in the existing bulk Grok rework queue, with team provisional assessments distinct from specific user grading. If the reference is genuinely ambiguous, report IDs and minimal clarification rather than imposing a generic thin ideal. All three prior slimmer v2 returns are present; return presence is distinct from artistic acceptance. Preserve hash-based lineage when filenames disagree with visible head type.
NO immediate Grok ping or generation: collect metadata first. Writing may continue using visibly qualified references while the audit finishes.

ACKNOWLEDGEMENT AND OWNERSHIP
Claude: acknowledge the two tracks, introduction/action focus and proportion caution, then name the next concrete writing output/path. CFA: acknowledge official-master intake readiness and persistence/task locations. A posted file or queued chat request is not acknowledgement.
Existing Flow/Grok/Comfy tests remain with their current owners and gates. No new paid generation, purchase, automatic run, duplicated assignment or public release is authorized here. Ancillary browser audits are deferred while Comfy owns the desktop; file/mail coordination can continue.

attachments.description: Consolidated direction/intake dependency attached to existing Claude Lisan writer pass; not a completed story.
